name: Release v2026.10.4
body:
## 🤖 AI-Generated Changelog

## Added
- Added interactive `pipenv init` command for creating a Pipfile with guided prompts

## Fixed
- Fixed `pipenv install -r` to decode requirements files using the same encoding detection as pip
- Fixed `pipenv audit` to exit with a non-zero status code when `pip-audit` cannot be run
- Fixed `pipenv graph` to print the missing virtualenv warning to stderr instead of stdout
- Fixed `pipenv outdated` to correctly interpolate the required version in skipped-update messages
- Fixed lockfile replacement to be atomic, preventing corruption on interrupted writes
- Fixed `pipenv install` to restore the Pipfile byte-for-byte when installation fails, including rolling back changes made by `pipenv init`
- Fixed Pipfile to be read and written as UTF-8 consistently across all operations

---

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pypa/pipenv/compare/v2026.10.3...v2026.10.4
